ticker_news.title: Muutokset Nokia Oyj:n omien osakkeiden omistuksessa
ticker_news.description: Nokia has transferred 11,148 of its own shares to participants of its stock-based incentive programs, reducing its treasury stock holdings to 64,685,389 shares.
ticker_news.author: Nokia Oyj

ticker_news.title: 2025 Q2 Earnings Season Off to a Strong Start After Bank Reports
ticker_news.description: Big banks reported strong Q2 profits driven by trading and investment banking, with cautious economic outlooks. Tech and industrial companies are set to report this week during peak earnings season from July 28 to August 15.
ticker_news.author: Christine Short

ticker_news.title: Earnings Season Looms Over Inflation Data, Tariff Impact
ticker_news.description: Inflation data shows mixed signals in the US, with core inflation rising 2.9% annually. Upcoming earnings season will feature major tech and consumer companies reporting, while the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank's monetary policies remain in focus.
ticker_news.author: Singapore Forex Club Benzinga Contributor

ticker_news.title: Nasdaq 100 Muted With Trade Tariffs and Tech Earnings in Focus
ticker_news.description: US stocks are expected to open muted as investors await trade deal developments and key tech earnings from Tesla and Alphabet. Trade tariffs and upcoming corporate reports are the primary market focus, with most S&P 500 companies beating earnings expectations so far.
ticker_news.author: Fiona Cincotta

ticker_news.title: 2 Stocks That Could Outperform With Earnings in Focus
ticker_news.description: The article analyzes Alphabet and IBM as potential investment opportunities, highlighting their complementary strengths in growth and stability ahead of their upcoming earnings reports.
ticker_news.author: Matteo Farci

QQQ.title: Redhawk Loads Up on 7,181 QQQ Shares in Q2 Filing
QQQ.description: Redhawk Wealth Advisors purchased 7,181 shares of QQQ, valued at $3.57 million, increasing its total QQQ position to 18,597 shares. The investment comes during a period of economic uncertainty, with the NASDAQ-100 index underperforming the S&P 500.
QQQ.author: Anders Bylund

QQQ.title: 5 Simple ETFs to Buy With $1,000 and Hold for a Lifetime
QQQ.description: The article discusses five recommended ETFs for long-term investors, focusing on diversification, growth, and income across different market segments including U.S. large-cap, technology, dividend, and international stocks.
QQQ.author: Geoffrey Seiler
